name: Tepui Parrotlet
rangeDescription: Tepuis of southern venezuela, southern guyana, and far northern brazil
description: The most numerous small parrot in the tepui highlands. Plumage entirely green with somewhat darker wings and a distinctive pale crescent below eye.

name: Meratus White-eye
rangeDescription: Meratus mountains, south kalimantan, southeastern borneo
description: A recently described species from montane rainforest in SE Borneo. Overall olive-green with a brighter yellow throat, undertail and belly stripe.

name: Tanimbar Bush Warbler
rangeDescription: Yamdena (tanimbar islands)
description: A long-billed brown warbler with a prominent buff eyebrow, a russet cap, a white throat, and a gray underside. An arboreal species that inhabits thick understory of forest, edges, bamboo thickets, and scrub.

name: Buru Golden-Bulbul
rangeDescription: Buru island (southern moluccas)
description: A thrush-sized olive-colored songbird with a long, fairly heavy bill. Plumage uniform olive-green except for narrow yellow chin, yellow patch between the bill and the eye, and partial yellow eye-ring above the eye.

name: Golden-winged Tody-Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Southeastern colombia (putumayo) to eastern ecuador and northeastern peru (loreto)
description: Small, colorful flycatcher found in lowland and foothill rainforest. Ranges primarily in eastern Ecuador, but also reaches adjacent areas of southern Colombia and northern Peru.

name: Carbonated Sierra Finch
rangeDescription: Pampas of central argentina; winters northward to tucumán
description: Plump tanager of arid lowlands in central Argentina, chiefly in northern Patagonian scrub. Similar to larger Mourning Sierra-Finch, but Carbonated has a less deeply curved top of bill, extensive black on underparts, and, in males, a pure yellow bill.

name: Wood Stork
rangeDescription: Southern usa to northern argentina, brazil, cuba, and hispaniola
description: Huge, long-legged, black-and-white waterbird, about the size of Great Blue Heron. White body with black flight feathers.

name: Donaldson Smith's Nightjar
rangeDescription: Northwestern and southern somalia, eastern and southern ethiopia, eastern kenya, and northeastern tanzania; possibly also in southeastern south sudan
description: A small, pretty nightjar with rufous tones in the plumage. Both sexes have small pale marks in the outer wings and at the corners of the tail.

name: Bahama Swallow
rangeDescription: Pine forest of northern bahamas; winters in bahamas and eastern cuba
description: An elegant aerial hunter most often found in pine woodlands, but also seen in towns and over fields. Note the long forked tail, green to blue-green upperparts, and white underparts.

name: Townsend's Warbler
rangeDescription: Coniferous forest of western north america; winters to costa rica
description: Brightly-colored warbler with a contrasting face pattern with dark cheeks and crown surrounded by bright yellow. Also shows olive back, bold white wingbars, and yellow on the breast.

name: Rudd's Lark
rangeDescription: High-altitude grassland of eastern south africa
description: A small, stocky lark with an upright posture, a large head, and a short narrow tail. The back is spangled with tawny, black, and, white, and the head is boldly marked with a conspicuous eyebrow, an eye-ring, and a diagnostic pale central crown stripe.

name: Tibetan Sandgrouse
rangeDescription: Desert of eastern afghanistan to tibetan plateau
description: A sandy-colored ground bird with a thin needle-point tail and a gentle, dove-like profile. Not as well-marked as other sandgrouse: soft sandy brown with a light orange face and finely barred breast.

name: Carruthers's Cisticola
rangeDescription: Democratic republic of the congo to uganda, western kenya, rwanda, burundi, and northwestern tanzania
description: Relatively colorful, mid-sized, long-tailed cisticola. Note the gray-brown back with thick black streaks, rufous on the wing and cap, and whitish underparts.

name: Cinnamon Screech-Owl
rangeDescription: Cloud forest of southern ecuador to northern peru
description: Small screech-owl with a scattered distribution in the Andes. It inhabits cloud forest in southeastern Ecuador and northern Peru, as well as a few locations in Colombia and Venezuela.

name: Scarlet-and-white Tanager
rangeDescription: Pacific slope of andes of colombia and northwestern ecuador
description: Scarce tanager found only in wet lowland and foothill rainforest in northwestern Ecuador and western Colombia. Fabulous male is unlike any other South American bird: he has glowing red plumage with white sides and slightly darker wings.

name: Mountain Sawwing
rangeDescription: Mountains of southeastern nigeria and southwestern cameroon; bioko
description: An entirely brownish-black swallow with darker wings and a forked tail. Often encountered in groups at the forest edge and in montane grassland.

name: Auckland Islands Shag
rangeDescription: Auckland islands
description: A medium-sized, black-and-white marine shag with a metallic green-and-blue glimmer on the black head and neck. Note the white wing patches.

name: Sangihe Hanging-Parrot
rangeDescription: Sangihe islands (north of sulawesi)
description: A tiny, green, very short-tailed parrot restricted to Sangihe Island. Mostly bright green with a red rump, upper tail, and throat in both sexes.

name: Golden-eared Tanager
rangeDescription: Andes of southwestern colombia to northwestern bolivia
description: Colorful cloud forest tanager found mainly along the east slope of the Andes. It is bluish-green with an orange face, coppery belly, and bold black markings on the head and back.

name: Green-backed Hillstar
rangeDescription: East slope of andes from southern colombia (nariño) to eastern ecuador (south at least to morona-santiago) and northern peru (amazonas, san martín)
description: Large hummingbird with limited range on east slope of Andes from southern Colombia to Ecuador. Overall bronzy-greenish with blue throat.
